mapper.select: SELECT social_id, provider, provider_user_id, social_access_token, social_refresh_token, connected_at, user_id FROM social_login WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_user_id = #{providerUserId} LIMIT 1

SELECT user_id, email, password, nickname, user_name, user_birth, gender, profile_image, role, login_type, status, point, subscription_grade, is_adult, is_noti_agree, is_terms_agreed, is_privacy_agreed, is_marketing_agreed, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user ( email, password, nickname, user_name, profile_image, role, login_type, status, point, subscription_grade, is_adult, is_noti_agree, is_terms_agreed, is_privacy_agreed, is_marketing_agreed, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{userName}, #{profileImage}, #{role}, #{loginType}, #{status}, #{point}, #{subscriptionGrade}, #{isAdult}, #{isNotiAgree}, #{isTermsAgreed}, #{isPrivacyAgreed}, #{isMarketingAgreed}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO social_login ( provider, provider_user_id, social_access_token, social_refresh_token, connected_at, user_id ) VALUES ( #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{socialAccessToken}, #{socialRefreshToken}, NOW(), #{userId} )
